newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Jinro Group sacks 74 executives.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Jinro Group sacks 74 executives.

text.p: South Korea's financially-troubled Jinro Group has sacked 74 executive members as part of a self-rescue plan, a group spokesman said on Friday.
The spokesman said the numbers accounted for 53 percent of the group's 140 executives and included two presidents.
But he brushed aside local media reports that the Jinro Group would soon cut the number of its employees.
"We will not hire new personnel but have no plan to reduce the current employees," he said.
The group would soon comply with an earlier pledged self-rescue plan to merge or sell off its affiliates.

The spokesman said group chairman Chang Jin-ho and his family gave up ownership and management rights in Jinro Mass-Merchandising Inc. Similiar action was expected in Jinro Construction on Friday or Saturday.

South Korean banks agreed to a 80.4 billion won emergency loan to the group. But the group chariman was first required to issue a letter authorising banks to dispose of his family's share of group affiliates.
